name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering in Medellin, he stumbled upon a Formula SAE team and was immediately captivated by the intricate design and sheer speed. He quickly shifted his focus to composite materials, recognizing their potential to revolutionize racing. After graduating, Ricardo spent several years honing his skills with a local aerospace firm before making the jump to racing.

He approaches his work with meticulous precision and a relentless pursuit of perfection. Ricardo believes that even the smallest improvement in composite design can translate into significant gains on the track. He is known for his ability to troubleshoot complex problems under pressure and his willingness to experiment with new materials and techniques. What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to adapt and innovate within the constraints of a racing team, always striving to find that competitive edge.

He's also very enthusiastic about sharing his knowledge with junior team members, believing that the next generation of composite technicians needs to be even better than the current one.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height and build with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always has a small arepa in his pocket as a snack.
Constantly hums quietly while working, usually traditional Colombian folk tunes.
Draws detailed diagrams on whiteboards before explaining any complex process.
